multiplierCurrentManaPercentage.rationale: Full mana, the neutral resource state, read only by skills whose data uses current mana (ifSkillData). Covered only while PoB hides it for the stage (D-250); shown, the plan lists it as earned state.

multiplierCurrentEnergyShield.rationale: Full energy shield, the neutral resource state, applied under UseCurrentEnergyShield (ifCond). Covered only while PoB hides it for the stage (D-250); shown, the plan lists it as earned state.

resourceGainMode.rationale: PoB's average resource gain, the neutral mode, read under AverageResourceGain (ifCond). Covered only while PoB hides it for the stage (D-250); shown, the plan lists it as earned state.

repeatMode.rationale: PoB's average over a skill's repeats, the neutral mode, read under alwaysFinalRepeat (ifCond). Covered only while PoB hides it for the stage (D-250); shown, the plan lists it as earned state.

ChanceToIgnoreEnemyPhysicalDamageReducti.rationale: PoB's average for a chance to ignore physical damage reduction, the neutral mode, read with that modifier (ifMod). Covered only while PoB hides it for the stage (D-250); shown, the plan lists it as earned state.

enemySizePreset.rationale: A medium-sized enemy, PoB's neutral size, read only by the size-dependent skills it names (ifSkill). Covered only while PoB hides it for the stage (D-250); shown, the plan lists it as earned state.

enemyLevel.rationale: PoB's placeholder for a non-boss enemyIsBoss class: the character's level, a level-appropriate enemy (ConfigOptions.lua:1969-1997). Not on a boss stage (D-252).

enemyArmour.rationale: PoB's placeholder for a non-boss enemyIsBoss class: its monster armour table at the enemy level (ConfigOptions.lua:1969-1997). Not on a boss stage (D-252).

enemyEvasion.rationale: PoB's placeholder for a non-boss enemyIsBoss class: its monster evasion table at the enemy level (ConfigOptions.lua:1969-1997). Not on a boss stage (D-252).

enemyPhysicalDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyLightningDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyColdDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyFireDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyChaosDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: a share of its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyLightningPen.rationale: PoB's penetration for a pinnacle or uber enemyIsBoss class (ConfigOptions.lua:2073-2075, 2114-2116); E1 records no enemy penetration to set instead.

enemyColdPen.rationale: PoB's penetration for a pinnacle or uber enemyIsBoss class (ConfigOptions.lua:2073-2075, 2114-2116); E1 records no enemy penetration to set instead.

enemyFirePen.rationale: PoB's penetration for a pinnacle or uber enemyIsBoss class (ConfigOptions.lua:2073-2075, 2114-2116); E1 records no enemy penetration to set instead.

enemyPhysicalOverwhelm.rationale: Its placeholder changes nothing: PoB's calculation reads another key for it (CalcDefence.lua:2113), so only an explicit value counts.

enemySpeed.rationale: PoB's default enemy attack and cast time (700 ms), its neutral enemy speed; E1 records no attack time to set instead.

enemyCritChance.rationale: PoB's default enemy critical hit chance for a non-boss enemy; a boss stage sets it from E1's base.crit-chance (D-252).

enemyCritDamage.rationale: PoB's default enemy critical damage bonus for a non-boss enemy; a boss stage sets it from E1's base.crit-bonus (D-252).

enemyDamageRollRange.rationale: PoB's default roll range for a boss skill's hit, read only while a boss skill preset is active (ifFlag BossSkillActive). Covered only while PoB hides it for the stage (D-250); shown, the plan lists it as earned state.

enemyDistance.rationale: PoB's default distance to the enemy (2 metres), its neutral range for distance-scaled accuracy and skills (CalcActiveSkill.lua:671).
